meanings.meaning: A small, dangerous creature, related to spiders, that lives in hot, dry places. It has claws and a curved stinger at the end of its tail that gives a very painful sting.
In 1 Kings 12:11, a harsh kind of whip, perhaps with knots or stones that gave a stinging pain. It may also be just a figure of speech for a very cruel punishment.
Wicked or hostile people, spoken of as if they were scorpions. In Ezekiel 2:6 it pictures dangerous people who could hurt someone.
